one_line: Film a 17 s hands-only demo with one text card per cut, and one comment word that sends the link.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld close-up of the Yookidoo box, a grey elephant funnel with colourful attachments filling the frame. No speech. Text from the first frame: "אצלנו בבית / זמן אמבטיה / הוא פעילות בפני עצמה", then "אמבטיה ארוכה וכיפית".
q1_hook.why: A bright, branded product fills the frame and a first-person line about the family's bath routine appears at 0:00 (H1, T3, H3, S1). It states the benefit, a long, calm bath, within 3 s (H2). No voice is heard, and the text is small over a busy picture (H4, H6, T4).

beats.what: Boxed elephant funnel; a toddler's hand reaches in; "אצלנו בבית זמן אמבטיה הוא פעילות בפני עצמה"
beats.why: Product and routine in text at once

beats.what: Hands hold the elephant under the shower hose; it hangs on the tile wall, spinners turn
The funnel fills and spills; water sprays from the trunk; a mermaid doll under the spray
beats.why: The water effects, one per cut

beats.what: A toddler's hands pour water and spin the flowers; "לחקור ולגלות לגעת ולהרגיש"
Attachments pushed into the funnel; "כל האביזרים נכנסים למשפך לאחסון נוח"; "המחיר הנגיש"
beats.why: A storage benefit and a price claim

beats.what: An adult hand holds the elephant, spraying; "רוצות גם? הגיבו "יוקידו""; fade to dark
beats.why: A one-word ask over the best shot

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen 0:14-0:16 and in the caption: comment "יוקידו" to get a purchase link by message. The caption also asks "רוצות קישור למשחק?". Nothing names a person to send it to.
q2_flow.why: A new shot every 1.3 s with a new water effect each time gives constant news (R3, E2), and at 17 s there is no dead air (R1, R2). The Reel ends on the ask, not on a child's reaction (R4). The comment word delivers a real link (R6).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:14-0:16: "רוצות גם? / הגיבו "יוקידו" / לקבלת קישור למשחק". Caption: "רוצות קישור למשחק? כתבו לי בתגובות ״יוקידו״ ואשלח לכן קישור לרכישה". Not spoken.
q3_cta.why: One action with a named reward, a brand word that delivers a purchase link, shown in the last 3 s and repeated in the caption (C1, C3, C6). It is not said, and it sits mid-frame, over the product (C6). The caption's first line is a feeling, not the ask.

q4_shown.what: The boxed toy 0:00; a child's hand reaching in 0:01; the elephant on a tile wall 0:04; filling and pouring 0:05-0:08; a mermaid doll under the spray 0:08; a toddler's hands 0:09-0:11; attachments stored 0:12; an adult hand 0:14. No price figure.
q4_shown.why: The product is handled from 0:01 and every claim is shown with water (S1, F8). Hands-only shots carry it with no face (S4, S5). The price line gives no number (S3). Disclosure is only the caption's last line (S7).

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 16.7 s, about 1.4 s each; cuts about every 1.3 s for the first 9 s, then 2.5 s, then 1.3 s. A new text card with almost every cut. No speech; music likely, not confirmed. A fade to dark ends it.
q5_edit.why: A regular beat of cuts keeps the pace high, though it is near the fast limit (E2, E1). Text changes with each cut, but each card holds only about 1.3 s for 40 to 55 characters, below a readable pace (T5, T2). The fade ends on the ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: An elephant bath toy that turns bath time into a long, calm play session, with a one-word offer for the link. Serves parents of young children.
q6_topic.why: Bath time is a daily parenting moment (K6), and a calm, cute demo suits it, though it is not a high-arousal peak (K1). A friend with a toddler is a natural person to send it to (R5), but the Reel does not ask.

q7_filmed.what: Handheld close-ups and some propped static shots in a tiled bathroom, warm artificial light; the toy and water fill the frame; low and high angles; a child's hands and an adult hand, no faces.
q7_filmed.why: Close shots make the toy and its water effects readable on a phone (F4, F5), and the home bathroom looks native (H8, F7). The text sits mid-frame over the toy (T4).

q8_text.on_screen: White text with no box, centred at about 45 to 60% of the frame height, 1 to 3 lines, a new card about every 1.3 s over the toy: "אצלנו בבית / זמן אמבטיה / הוא פעילות בפני עצמה" (0:00), "והבנות לא עוזבות אותו" (0:04), "אפשר לשחק עם כל חלק בנפרד" (0:09), "המחיר הנגיש הוא הדובדבן שבקצפת" (0:13), "רוצות גם? הגיבו "יוקידו" לקבלת קישור למשחק" (0:14).
q8_text.caption: "יש משחקים שאני יודעת מהרגע הראשון שיש בבם משהו מיוחד 🐘💦". About 55 words: a hook, a benefit line, "המלצת זהב", the ask with the word "יוקידו", then "בשיתוף משמח עם @palphot". No hashtags.
q8_text.why: A headline card in the first second names the topic (T3), and with no speech the text carries the message muted (T1). Cards flash for 1.3 s, too short to read in full, over the product (T5, T2). The caption's keywords and ask are clear (T7); the disclosure is in words but last (T8).

weak_points: Text cards held about 1.3 s each, too fast to read; no voice and no personal reaction; no price figure; a disclosure only in the last caption line; the "accessible price" claim is unsupported.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a 15 to 20 s hands-only demo, one cut and one card per page, hold each card 2 s, and put one comment word on the last 3 s.
not_verified: Whether music plays (the transcript's only line is a hallucination). The toy's price, and whether the retailer paid for the post beyond the caption words. The children's ages (hands only). Correction to src/coded: a child's hand appears in 0:01, and the adult hand at 0:14 is the only adult hand; the caption has no hashtags. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
